description.value: X-Site Grill & Bistro is a family-owned sit-down restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby, serving a broad menu spanning starters, pastas, grilled mains, and hand-held sandwiches. The kitchen makes several house-made sauces and the menu spans casual comfort food with Greek and North American influences. It sits on a main east-west arterial that connects Burnaby to Vancouver and Coquitlam, making it a potential mid-ride meal stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active with a full menu and matching contact details (phone, address). No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. Multiple menu items on the /menu subpage are explicitly labeled 'Vegetarian', providing positive evidence for that amenity.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly active and would serve touring cyclists on a busy arterial, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify these before inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly labeled 'Vegetarian' on website: Tzatziki, Hummus, X-site Spuds, Cheese Garlic Bread, and Nachos

wow_evidence: family-owned sit-down restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby
